metaDescription: ChatGPT is OpenAI's AI assistant for writing, research, analysis, image creation and coding with Codex. See its features, Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise pricing, strengths, limitations and alternatives.
overview: ChatGPT is OpenAI's conversational AI assistant. It helps with writing, brainstorming, research, analysis and coding, and can search the web, work with uploaded files, create images and hold voice conversations.

Its desktop app combines Chat, ChatGPT Work and Codex in one place, so you can run longer projects, work with files and code across your computer. Every plan includes unlimited everyday text chats, subject to guardrails; paid plans add advanced reasoning models, more uploads, image creation, deep research and Codex usage. ChatGPT runs on the web, Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android.

features.title: Chat and web search
features.text: Unlimited everyday text chats on every plan, with real-time answers from the web.

features.title: Files, images and voice
features.text: Upload files, create images and talk to ChatGPT by voice, with higher limits on paid plans.

features.title: Deep research
features.text: Run multi-step research on a topic; limited on Free and Go, expanded on Plus and Pro.

features.title: Codex and ChatGPT Work
features.text: Agentic coding and long-running work in the desktop app, sharing one usage allowance.

features.title: Projects and memory
features.text: Organise chats and files into projects, with memory that grows on higher plans.

features.title: Custom GPTs and tasks
features.text: Use custom GPTs and schedule tasks to run later; scheduled tasks start on the Go plan.

useCases: Research and analysis with web search
Creating images for posts and presentations
Team work with shared projects on Business
strengths: A free plan with unlimited everyday text chats, web search and projects.
A wide range of tools in one app: research, images, voice and coding.
Desktop apps for Windows and Mac, plus iPhone and Android apps.
Plans scale from an $8/mo Go plan up to Pro, Business and Enterprise.
limitations: Uploads, image creation, voice, deep research and memory are limited on the free plan.
The Go plan may include ads.
Advanced reasoning models need Plus or higher, and usage limits apply.
Pro starts at $100/mo, and its fastest mode needs the $500/mo tier.
Business needs at least 2 users; Enterprise and Edu pricing isn't published.

pricing.summary: Free plan available. Prices are in USD; Go pricing is localized in some markets. Business and Enterprise teams can buy credits for more access, and nonprofits can get up to 75% off Business or Enterprise.

plans.name: Free
plans.note: Unlimited text chats · limited uploads, images, voice, deep research and Codex

plans.name: Go
plans.note: More messages with tools, uploads, images and voice · longer memory · may include ads

plans.name: Plus
plans.note: Advanced reasoning models · expanded deep research · more Codex usage

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Tiers at $100, $200 or $500/mo · maximum deep research · Ultrafast mode on $500

plans.name: Business
plans.note: 2+ users, billed yearly, or $25/user monthly · option to buy credits
